title: Kuro's Voice
summary: Kuro manifests as a spectral demonic guardian on the university rooftop. He reveals the shocking truth: Ha-Jun carries the ancient bloodline of the First Demon Sovereign, and his missing elder brother Tae-Jun is still alive trapped inside the Nether Boundary.

panels.action: A single swirling violet magical ember hovers gently in the rain, emitting faint whisper frequencies directly into the air.
The purple ember expands rapidly into ethereal black and violet demonic miasma, taking the spectral form of an ancient feathered familiar.
Ha-Jun scuffles backward along the wet rooftop floor in panic, pressing his back against the parapet: 'K-Kaun hai wahan?!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: KAUN HAI WAHAN?! SAMNE AAO!

panels.action: Kuro perches regally on the severed steel terrace railing, his obsidian feathers tipped with violet flames, glowing crimson eyes gleaming.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Aawaz neeche karo, ladke. Agar main dushman hota, toh wo Imp abhi tumhari haddiyan chaba raha hota.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes widen as he recognizes the distinct silhouette and glowing feathers of the mysterious bird from earlier.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh wahi parinda hai... jo pehle railing par baitha tha!

panels.action: Kuro flares his wings outward, sending a cascade of harmless violet sparks floating through the rain with deep, aristocratic laughter.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Sirf ek parinda? Kitni gustaakhi hai. Main Kuro hoon—First Demon Sovereign ka Shahi Muhafiz.

panels.action: Kuro extends a glowing spectral talon, pointing directly at the center of Ha-Jun's chest where the violet core pulses.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Aur tum... is yug ke aakhri Sovereign ho.

panels.action: Ha-Jun shakes his head vigorously, rain droplets flying from his wet bangs: 'Sovereign?! Main toh sirf ek aam student hoon!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mazaak mat karo! Main Saint Mirren ka sabse kamzor ladka hoon!

panels.action: Kuro's beak forms a mocking, knowing grin: 'Aam insaan? Koi aam insaan meri feather ko chhoote hi raakh ka dher ban jaata.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Koyi aam insaan meri Mythic Relic ko bardasht nahi kar sakta.

panels.action: Flashback to the primordial Abyss: The First Demon Sovereign seated upon a colossal obsidian throne beneath twin shattered purple moons.

dialogue.text: Hazaaron saal pehle... First Demon Sovereign ne Abyss par raaj kiya tha.

panels.action: Ten glowing sacred artifacts (Feather, Ring, Bone, Heart, Fang, Eye, Chains, Crown, Eclipse, Hourglass) orbit in a celestial circle.

dialogue.text: Apne ant se pehle... usne apni taqat ko Das Relics mein baant diya.

panels.action: A glowing crimson and violet genetic tree weaves through human history, hiding in plain sight across mortal generations.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Uska khoon sadiyon tak insaano ke beech chupa raha... tumhare jism tak pahunchne ke liye.

panels.action: Ha-Jun looks down at his pale hands, now healed and humming with supernatural warmth beneath the skin.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Toh kya... yeh aag... mere andar pehle se thi?

panels.action: Kuro's tone softens into somber gravity: 'Aur yeh khoon sirf isliye bacha... kyunki tumhare bade bhai ne apni jaan daav par laga di.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Tumhare bhai Kang Tae-Jun ne tumhari hifazat ke liye sab kuch qurbaan kar diya.

panels.action: Ha-Jun freezes, his heart skipping a beat as his brother's name echoes in his ears like lightning.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: TUM BHAIYA KO JAANTE HO?!

panels.action: Ha-Jun scrambles forward, desperately reaching out toward Kuro's perch: 'Kahan hain wo?! Kya wo zinda hain?!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: MUJHE BATAO! WO KAHAN HAIN?!

panels.action: Kuro meets Ha-Jun's gaze with ancient sorrow: 'Wo pehle candidate the. Lekin unka jism Sovereign ke pure harmony ko nahi sambhaal saka.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Wo pichhle uttaradhikari the... par unka jism is bojh ko nahi seh paya.

panels.action: Brief memory fragment: Kang Tae-Jun smiling back as demonic chains drag him into the dark dimensional void.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Us raat wo Abyss Hounds ko tumhare peeche se hata kar Nether Boundary mein le gaye.

panels.action: In deep darkness, a faint blue soul flame continues burning stubbornly: 'Lekin unki rooh ka diya abhi tak bujha nahi hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Wo abhi bhi zinda hain, Ha-Jun.

panels.action: A single fresh tear rolls down Ha-Jun's cheek, but his expression shifts from crushing despair into burning hope.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Wo... zinda hain...!

panels.action: Kuro's eyes glow with warning: 'Zinda hain, par qaid hain. Aur ab jab tumhara khoon jaag chuka hai, poori duniya tumhare peeche aayegi.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Abyss ke Demon Lords aur insaano ke Demon Hunters... dono tumhara shikar karenge.

panels.action: Far below the campus gates, distant red and blue police / hunter sirens flicker against the wet city pavement.
Kuro flies down and alights firmly on Ha-Jun's left shoulder, his feathers solidifying into sleek black plumage with purple tips.
Kuro speaks directly into Ha-Jun's ear: 'Tumhare paas do raaste hain. Ya toh chuhe ki tarah chup jao aur mare jao...'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Pehla: Ek buzdil ki tarah chup jao aur maut ka intezar karo...

panels.action: Kuro continues: '...Ya baaki Nau Relics ko dhoond kar, Abyss ko cheer kar apne bhai ko wapas le aao.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Ya fir baaki 9 Relics jeet kar, Abyss ko cheer kar apne bhai ko laao!

panels.action: Ha-Jun slowly pushes himself up from the wet floor, standing tall against the stormy city skyline, chin held high.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Maine ek baar unhe chhod kar bhaag gaya tha...

panels.action: Ha-Jun firmly clenches his right fist; faint purple sparks crackle between his knuckles without any trembling.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: ...Lekin ab main dubara kabhi nahi bhaagunga!

panels.action: Close-up portrait: Ha-Jun's violet demonic irises burn with cold, radiant sovereign fire, completely extinguishing all weakness.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main bhaiya ko bachaunga. Chahe poori duniya mere khilaaf khadi ho jaye.

panels.action: Kuro spreads his dark wings with satisfaction: 'Yeh hui na baat, mere Sovereign. Toh chalo, pehla shart poora karo.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Shabash. Ab system ka pehla contract accept karo.

panels.action: The holographic obsidian system interface flashes in front of Ha-Jun with glowing runes: [WILL YOU BIND YOUR SOUL TO THE DEMON SOVEREIGN CONTRACT? [ACCEPT] / [DECLINE]].

dialogue.text: [ACCEPT THE DEMON SOVEREIGN CONTRACT?]
